# Independent Advisory

> Independent research, assessment and acquisition advisory for collectors of historically significant motor cars. Based in Berlin, Germany, with work spanning Europe and the United States.

The advisory process begins with the collector's requirements: period, model, coachwork, specification, provenance, originality, restoration history, condition and intended use. It may involve searching for suitable cars, examining historical records and individual vehicles, coordinating specialist inspections, assessing findings and assisting with acquisition.

Enquiries are handled confidentially. The advisor works in English, German and Russian.

## Advisory

- [Home](https://oldtimerberater.eu/): Overview of the independent advisory service and its approach to searching for historically significant motor cars.
- [Method](https://oldtimerberater.eu/method/): The collector's mandate, research, historical evidence, vehicle examination, independent judgement and acquisition assistance.
- [The Advisor](https://oldtimerberater.eu/advisor/): Location, geographical scope, languages and approach to discretion.
- [Private Enquiries](https://oldtimerberater.eu/contact/): Email and telephone contact for confidential enquiries.

## Optional
